INS_NM contains the insured's full name (First Last format), but the canonical schema has no dedicated field for insured_name. This personal data belongs in extended_attributes rather than a canonical policy field.

INS_ADDR is the insured's street address, but the canonical policy schema has no dedicated address field. This belongs in extended_attributes where address details are typically managed outside the core policy entity.

INS_CITY is confirmed by the value catalog as 'Insured city name', but canonical lookup returns no matching city or address-related field. This insured address component belongs in extended_attributes rather than a core schema field.

[critic override] INS_ST is the insured's home state, not a policy region or territory code; it belongs in extended_attributes, and the proposed_target of null with no wrapping is incomplete — it must be explicitly routed to extended_attributes.

[critic override] A ZIP code is PII address data with no match to customer_id (a surrogate key), and casting it to INTEGER would corrupt leading-zero ZIPs like 07101; it must go to extended_attributes as a string.

INS_SSN_LAST4 is a 4-digit SSN fragment (PII), which has no canonical field in the insurance policy schema. It belongs in extended_attributes as custom/sensitive data that cannot be safely mapped to standard policy fields like customer_id.

[critic override] WRTG_AGT is a string agency code (e.g. 'AGY00012'), not a numeric agent_id; the proposed target of null is directionally right but must be explicitly mapped to extended_attributes rather than left unmapped.

UW_TIER is a coded underwriting tier classification (T1/T2/T3) derived from risk score, but the canonical schema has no corresponding tier field. Although semantically related to risk_score, it represents a categorical segmentation rather than the numeric score itself, so it belongs in extended_attributes.

[critic override] The canonical premium_amount field is always annual; mapping a monthly premium amount to it would produce a value 12x too small, so this must go to extended_attributes as monthly_premium with the cents conversion retained.

ADDL_INS_1_NM contains additional insured names, which is not a canonical policy schema field. This extended policy detail should be stored in extended_attributes as a structured additional insured record.

ADDL_INS_1_REL is a coded relationship type for an additional insured (spouse, child, parent, partner/guardian, other), but the canonical schema has no dedicated field for additional insured relationships. This structured detail belongs in extended_attributes.

ADDL_INS_2_REL is a coded relationship field for a second additional insured (values: SP, CH, PR, PG, OT). While it is properly categorized as a coded column, there is no corresponding canonical field in the schema for additional insured relationship codes. This is a supplemental policy attribute that belongs in extended_attributes.

ADDL_INS_3_NM (Additional Insured 3 Name) does not map to a canonical policy field. Additional insured information is extended policy metadata, not a primary schema element. The column is also completely null (100% null rate) with no actual data values.

ADDL_INS_3_REL is a coded field for the third additional insured's relationship (SP/CH/PR/PG/OT). Additional insured relationship details are not part of the core canonical policy schema and belong in extended_attributes.

ADDL_INS_4_NM represents the 4th additional insured's name, which is not a standard canonical policy field. The column is 100% null with no sample data, and no canonical target field semantically matches 'additional insured name'. Route to extended_attributes.

ADDL_INS_4_REL is an additional insured relationship code (SP/CH/PR/PG/OT), which does not map to any canonical field in the standard schema. This specialized attribute belongs in extended_attributes.

ADDL_INS_5_NM represents additional insured name (the 5th additional insured), which is a supplementary policy attribute not mapped in the canonical schema. The column is also completely null in the source data. Route to extended_attributes.

ADDL_INS_5_REL is a relationship code for an additional insured (values: SP, CH, PR, PG, OT), which is domain-specific supplementary data without a corresponding canonical field. This belongs in extended_attributes.

[critic override] PRIOR_CARR_CD contains 3-char abbreviated carrier codes (e.g. 'ALL', 'NAT'), not a carrier name; the canonical prior_carrier field expects a carrier name or full identifier, so the raw abbreviation code should be preserved in extended_attributes pending a lookup translation.
